csv_project_name: AE for Montrose Field House Renovation
csv_scope_of_work: The Montrose Recreation District (MRD) is soliciting Statements of Qualifications and Proposals from qualified Architectural and Engineering (A/E) firms to provide professional design and construction administration services in support of the renovation of the Montrose Field House located in Montrose, Colorado.The intent of this RFQ/P is to identify a qualified consultant team with demonstrated experience in recreation, athletic, and community facility renovations, including stakeholder engagement, facility programming, sustainable design, phased construction coordination, and public-sector project delivery.MRD seeks a consultant team capable of providing comprehensive professional services from conceptual planning and schematic design through construction administration and project closeout
csv_disciplines_requested: Architecture Services, Interior Design/Space Planning, Rehabilitation & Refurbishment, Civil Engineering, Construction/Project Management, Fire Protection Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Structural Engineering

title: A/E Services for Montrose Field House Renovation
short_description: Design and construction administration for renovation of a community athletic field house.
project_scope: Renovation of the Montrose Field House in Montrose, Colorado. The project concerns a recreation, athletic, and community facility renovation and includes stakeholder engagement, facility programming, sustainable design, phased construction coordination, and public-sector delivery. No gross floor area, structural spans, or detailed technical quantities are stated in the notice.
services: Comprehensive architectural and engineering services from conceptual planning and schematic design through construction administration and project closeout, including architecture, interior design/space planning, rehabilitation and refurbishment, civil engineering, structural engineering, fire protection engineering, mechanical engineering, and construction administration/project management.
relevance_explanation:
- Sports and recreation facility projects are generally relevant to sbp.
- The tender includes structural engineering as part of a multidisciplinary design team.
- Early-stage design involvement from concept through construction administration is strategically positive.
- Sustainable design is explicitly mentioned.
- However, this is a renovation of a field house with no stated long spans, special roof structures, or unusual structural challenges.
- The notice appears architecture-led and broad, so direct structural innovation potential is unclear.
construction_cost_explanation: No construction budget is stated in the tender notice. Available cost-relevant information: renovation of an existing field house/community athletic facility; phased construction coordination; public-sector delivery; full design and construction administration services requested. Without area, program, or scope quantities, a realistic USD estimate is not reliable.
fee_explanation: No design fee or engineering fee is stated in the tender notice. Fee estimation is not reliable because no construction budget, floor area, or structural scope is provided.
references_qualifications: Qualified A/E firms with demonstrated experience in recreation, athletic, and community facility renovations. The consultant team should show experience in stakeholder engagement, facility programming, sustainable design, phased construction coordination, and public-sector project delivery.
contracting_authority: Montrose Recreation District, Montrose, Colorado, USA. Contact: Jeremy Master. Phone: 970-249-7831. Fax: 970-249-2750. Email: jeremy@montroserec.com. Website: https://www.montroserec.com/request-for-proposals-rfp
notes: Project number RFQP26-7. Target market: Parks. Pre-submittal meeting: 2026-05-20 02:00 PM MDT at 1227 Mayfly Dr, Montrose, CO 81401, USA; attendance recommended. Questions due 2026-05-22 10:00 AM MDT. Solicitation documents available online. Source labels the procurement as RFQ/P for Statements of Qualifications and Proposals.
